title: The Information Profiles Cami Clark — Dario Amodei’s Wife, Ivanka Trump’s Friend, One-Time Would-Be Pornographer, and Anthropic’s ‘First Lady’
content_html:
Cory Weinberg, Jemima McEvoy, Jessica E. Lessin, and Stephanie Palazzolo, writing for the paywalled-without-gift-links The Information:

As Amodei has hopscotched the globe to preach about the potential and risks of AI — from New Delhi to Davos to Sun Valley — Clark has almost always been near his side. Several people who know the couple describe Clark as Amodei’s emotional ballast, someone he has sought counsel from during the turbulence of Anthropic’s growth and clashes with Washington over the future of AI.

Clark may well be the most consequential person within Anthropic’s orbit who doesn’t have a formal role at the startup. You might even call her the first lady of Anthropic. [...]

And before Female Algorithm Technologies, Clark tried her hand at building a pornographic film company, Eddice, that planned to make movies with high-production values and female protagonists. She also hoped it would have online shopping capabilities. In 2011, she tried to raise money for Eddice from Jeffrey Epstein, who’d pleaded guilty to charges of soliciting a minor for prostitution three years earlier, according to emails made public as part of the Epstein files released by the Department of Justice earlier this year. She emailed Epstein the script for the first of a series of films they hoped to make (title: “American Girl in Paris”).

“We thought you and the ladies might enjoy,” Clark wrote. She then appended a winking warning: “A little nsfw,” an acronym for “not safe for work.” Epstein didn’t invest.

While enormous attention has fallen on AI and the people behind the companies developing it, Clark has largely flown under the radar.

content_html_zh:
科里·温伯格、杰米玛·麦克沃伊、杰西卡·E. Lessin 和 Stephanie Palazzolo，为付费墙无礼物链接撰写文章 信息：

当阿莫迪在全球范围内传播人工智能的潜力和风险时——从新德里到达沃斯再到太阳谷——克拉克几乎总是在他身边。 一些认识这对夫妇的人将克拉克描述为阿莫迪的情感稳定器，在 Anthropic 发展的动荡以及与华盛顿就人工智能的未来发生冲突期间，他曾向克拉克寻求建议。

克拉克很可能是 Anthropic 轨道上最有影响力的人，但他在这家初创公司中没有担任正式职务。 你甚至可以称她为人类的第一夫人。 [...]

在女性算法技术公司之前，克拉克曾尝试建立一家色情电影公司艾迪斯（Eddice），该公司计划制作高产值和女性主角的电影。 她还希望它具有在线购物功能。 2011年，她试图从杰弗里·爱泼斯坦那里为埃迪斯筹集资金，根据今年早些时候司法部公布的爱泼斯坦档案中公开的电子邮件，杰弗里·爱泼斯坦三年前承认了招揽未成年人卖淫的指控。 她通过电子邮件向爱泼斯坦发送了他们希望制作的系列电影中第一部的剧本（标题：“巴黎的美国女孩”）。

“我们认为你和女士们可能会喜欢，”克拉克写道。 然后她附加了一个眨眼警告：“有点nsfw”，是“工作不安全”的缩写。 爱泼斯坦没有投资。

尽管人工智能及其开发公司背后的人员受到了极大的关注，但克拉克却基本上没有受到关注。
